title: Building again asks to confirm, based on the inspection as it is now
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit' and 'Work orders - Create & Edit', on the build under test; ShopCoach is enabled and the shop has at least one labor type.
  2. An inspection already built from through another entry point (e.g. its completed screen), whose report note is still on the work order.
custom_steps:
1. From the note, press Build lines on an inspection that has already been built from elsewhere.
2. Confirm the confirmation prompt is based on the inspection's current state rather than on the note's snapshot.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The re-build confirmation is based on the inspection's current state rather than on the note, so a build done elsewhere afterwards still triggers the warning.
  • If the inspection was already built from through another entry point, the user is asked to confirm.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9102 (S4 — Build from the inspection note on a work order); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S4; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R3: “The confirmation in S2-R13 will be based on the inspection's current state rather than on the note. The note reflects the inspection as it was when it completed, so a build performed elsewhere afterwards would otherwise go unnoticed and the same findings could be built twice without warning”
  • S4-E2: “If the inspection was already built from through another entry point, the user is asked to confirm”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
